description:
Cast Essence Flux by paying {U}, targeting  Salvager of Secrets
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve Essence Flux, blinking Salvager of Secrets
When Salvager of Secrets enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Essence Flux to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat.
